integrity: The bundled standalone verifier reconstructs the channel, distance, compatibility graph, complete equality census, orbit decomposition and invariants from definitions. The two closest primary papers were inspected in full for statement-level comparison. The scientific claim has undergone self-review; no independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Finite exact classification for binary length seven and correction of at most two unidirectional errors. The proof is computer-assisted and exhaustive. The stated two-orbit classification uses coordinate permutations and global complementation and does not assert that this is the full abstract automorphism group. An obscure or unindexed historical enumeration cannot be excluded completely.
title: Equality cases for binary length-seven two-unidirectional-error codes
